plainTranslation: Deep loyalty, real weight. The Saturn person steadies the Moon person; the Moon person can feel judged or held at arm's length. Built to last, or built to chill. Say the warmth out loud or it goes cold. If it's duty without affection, name that.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
